reserveReview.rationale: GAIB's deployed transparency module accessed 2026-09-30 still discloses facility principal allocations of $5.4 million, $10.5 million and $2.8 million. These are the existing principal-allocation denominator convention, not audited current fair values or the separately displayed remainingPrincipal. Exact registry-qualified balanceOf reads found 214,915.429119 USDC across Ethereum redeemer 0x52323f33551188f170d8de14fe8d8423a839629d, minter 0xe2e1424687eb676b3807693cbb439362b8ea908e and sAID reserve 0xdaed70e64aaea8efff8fe150ee7762210aed2e9b at block 26088275, Arbitrum minter 0x04dfa27c7d1ade09ddfccfa233fb3c8490ca2b18 at block 510256611, and Base minter 0x81c1fba2c7df54ac76de5ebe373e89bcad3b8632 at block 51978808. BSC block 124854510 returned 5.536064300516316 Binance-Peg USDT at minter 0x66f9383271af3cb719b17ad07a2389185a3f580a from token 0x55d398326f99059ff775485246999027b3197955. The measured liquid balances plus disclosed principals total $18,914,920.965183303 and are normalized to 100%; cross-chain observations are not atomic. The USDT issuer edge is withheld because these balances establish a BSC representation, not verified canonical escrow coverage.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer-disclosed facility principal allocations plus exact multichain liquid token balances observed 2026-09-30; not a fair-value attestation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Facility principal allocations are issuer disclosure rather than independently verified current NAV. Binance-Peg USDT canonical escrow coverage remains unverified.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-2 (lead buidl-blackrock)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: GAIB documents the on-chain Minter and Redeemer contracts that accept USDC/USDT, but what happens to proceeds after minting, conversion into Treasuries, custodian identities, account segregation, insolvency protections, and reuse terms, is off-chain and undocumented. The June 2026 Spiceflow assurance report covers GPU-financing asset deployment, not AID reserve custody, and no AID reserve attestation is publicly retrievable.
